structured_output.summary:
SPEC-0336: gates now get /dev/null as stdin instead of the job stream, the cache fetch works on git older than 2.29, validation is stricter (non-finite budget, NUL bytes, gate names that collide with another gate's retry files), gc --keep-days is capped, and new tests cover the origin/main base, the budget deadline, worker env, have edge cases, SIGHUP and the docs.

Code changes in worker.py: the stdin watcher reads a private dup of the job fd, and fd 0 is replaced with /dev/null, so a gate that reads stdin gets EOF at once. The cache fetch no longer passes the git 2.29-only flags (the cache config already turns auto gc off). An origin/<rest> base sets core.warnAmbiguousRefs=false in the job tree so resolving it prints no ambiguity warning. Validation refuses NaN/Infinity gate_budget_s, NUL bytes in env values and in gate fields, and a gate named `<other gate>.r<n>`. gc caps --keep-days at 100000. I could not edit Design step 4 (the spec is guarded), so the slot campaign id `remote:<campaign>` is recorded in As shipped. The targeted set (184 tests) passed in all 12 repeat runs at -n 4/6/8, and the spec's test record says so. The loop 6 one-off failure did not recur, but its cause is still unidentified.
tests_run: with the stdin, origin-ref and slot-hold-deadline fixes temporarily reverted: the 3 matching new tests failed; restored

12x uv run pytest -q -n {4,6,8} tests/test_worker.py tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py tests/test_gate_slots.py tests/test_cli_gate_slots.py tests/test_agentic_gates.py tests/test_rich_output_guard.py tests/test_test_waits.py: 184 passed every run

ac_status.ac: valid header+bundle runs gates, emits accepted/started/gate/done with files
merge-base $NW_BASE HEAD matches the coordinator (now also for an origin/main base)
env outside allowlist -> validate error; reused job_id -> claim error
concurrent jobs with different base.sha see their own base
EOF mid-gate / during slot wait -> done interrupted (and SIGHUP is now tested too)
log over 16 MiB truncated with truncated_bytes
have after job; gc --keep-days 0 removes refs/objects/job dirs except a live job's
ssh-command execs the 4 allowed subcommands, refuses the rest with exit 2
WORKFLOW.md documents the mandatory dedicated user and the key line (now also checked by a test)

followup_ideas: The local run_gate also inherits the runner's stdin; consider stdin=DEVNULL in gates.run_gate for local runs too
Gate timeout_s accepts arbitrarily large ints (project.validate), so proc.wait(timeout=huge) could raise OverflowError; cap it in project.validate
Local gate names `a` and `a.r1` collide on retry files too; project.validate could apply the same retry-stem rule the worker now uses
